scripts.dev: bun run dev:client & bun run dev:api
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:api
scripts.bump: bunx npm-check-updates -u -ws -root && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:interactive: bunx npm-check-updates -i -ws -root && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:minor: bunx npm-check-updates -u -ws -root --target minor && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:patch: bunx npm-check-updates -u -ws -root --target patch && bun install && bun run update:bun
